beautiful_update.prompt_text:
You are taking over as Lead Visual Architect and Gothic Bio-Engineer for a Farkle-based match-3 puzzle game.
Your creative mandate is to build TWO living worlds: THE LIBRA SANCTUARY — the Ivory Lobby. Bone, glass, liquid gold. A futuristic cathedral where you prepare. THE SCORPIO GRID — the Obsidian Neural Core. Chitinous, bioluminescent, predatory. Where the game actually happens.
The interface is not a screen. It is a SYNTHETIC ORGANISM. Every color, particle, and sound must reinforce this.
Before touching a single file, complete Phase 0. Do not skip questions. Do not assume. Ask everything.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PHASE 0 — MANDATORY QUESTIONS
Ask every question below. Wait for all answers before proceeding.
Q1. FRAMEWORK + RENDERER What frontend framework? (React, Vue, vanilla JS, other?) How are the 3D dice currently rendered? (CSS 3D transforms, Three.js, a 2D canvas library, or other?) This determines how die states and overlays are applied.
Q2. CHAIN BUG — EXACT SYMPTOMS Describe what happens when you drag to chain tiles. Which part breaks: tile selection, adjacency checking, chain commit on release, or something else? Does the chain register any tiles at all?
Q3. SCORING ENGINE CRITICAL CHECK Show me the current scoring function. Specifically: how does it handle [1,1,1,2,2,2]? The correct answer is 2500 (Two Triplets). If it returns 1200 (Three 1s + Three 2s), the scorer is broken and must be replaced before any visual work is meaningful. IMPORTANT: The document showing this code is NOT the correct implementation: totalScore += (counts[1] || 0) * 100; ← This scores [1,1,1] as 300. Wrong. Should be 1000. The correct scorer uses maximum partition — exhaustive recursive search. Confirm which scorer is running.
Q4. FILE NAMES What are the names of: - Die/tile rendering component - Grid/board component - Game state (the useGame equivalent) - Audio hook (the useAudio equivalent) - Main CSS file or design token file
Q5. CURRENT VISUAL STATE What do the dice look like right now? (3D CSS, flat colored squares, SVG, canvas-drawn, or other?) Do any blocker visuals exist yet? Is there any particle system at all?
Q6. CASCADE TIMING What is the delay between gravity steps in milliseconds? Is it a named constant? What is it called? I need approval to change it from its current value to 160ms for physics gravity animation. Confirm: approved or not?
Q7. MOTION/REACT Is motion/react (formerly Framer Motion) installed? Run: npm list motion If not: do you want it added for physics layout animation? (~30KB)
Q8. AUDIO STATE What sounds exist right now? Are they synthesized (Web Audio API) or loaded from files? Have the ambient music stems been sourced yet? (ambient.mp3 / strings.mp3 / choir.mp3 / electronic.mp3 — all same duration)
Q9. WILD BLOCKER Does a Wild tile type exist in the engine? If yes: does the scorer expose the resolved face value to the UI during chain building (so the UI can show which face Wild resolves to)?
Q10. THEME DIRECTION CONFIRMATION Confirm you want the dual-theme Gothic Bio-Architecture: Libra (Lobby): Ivory Sanctuary — alabaster, gold circulatory lines, organic curved borders, translucent glass membranes Scorpio (Grid): Obsidian Neural Core — deep black, bioluminescent cyan, arterial crimson, chitinous textures, pulsing nerve glows Is this the vision? Or any adjustments?
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PHASE 1 — SCORING ENGINE VERIFICATION
This runs before any visual work. A beautiful game built on a broken scorer is worthless.
Run all 16 test cases against the current scorer:
[1] → 100 [5] → 50 [3] → 0 (Farkle) [1,1,1] → 1000 (NOT 300) [2,2,2] → 200 [6,6,6] → 600 [1,1,1,5] → 1050 [1,1,1,5,5] → 1100 [1,2,3,4,5,6] → 1500 [1,1,1,2,2,2] → 2500 (NOT 1200 — Two Triplets beats separate triples) [1,1,1,1] → 1000 [5,5,5,5,5] → 2000 [3,3,3,3,3,3] → 3000 [1,1,2,2,3,3] → 1500 [1,1,1,1,2,2] → 1500 [2,3,4] → 0 (Farkle)
If any test fails: fix the scorer first. Do not proceed until all 16 pass. The scorer must use maximum-partition exhaustive search — not greedy selection.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PHASE 2 — CHAIN LOGIC DEBUG
Read the chain selection code. Identify which issues are present:
POINTER CAPTURE BUG (most common post-engine-swap issue): In the onPointerDown handler on each tile, add: e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId) Without this, the browser routes all drag events to the first tile touched. Neighbor tiles never fire onPointerEnter.
ADJACENCY CHECK: Must use Manhattan distance: Math.abs(rowA-rowB) + Math.abs(colA-colB) === 1 Diagonal (1,1) returns false. Distance (2,0) returns false.
BACKTRACK: Re-entering the second-to-last tile removes the last tile. Re-entering any other existing tile is silently ignored.
COMMIT: Chain must commit on pointerup AND on pointer leaving the grid container. If only pointerup: dragging off-grid leaves a ghost chain active.
SYNAPTIC NERVE LINK VISUAL: When tiles are chained, draw an SVG path between their center points. This is the "Bio-Link" — a glowing neural connection between chained dice. Implementation: a single SVG overlay over the grid (absolute positioned, pointer-events none). For each consecutive pair in the chain, draw:
SVG filter for nerve-glow:
The nerve color matches the gem glow of the most common face in the chain. If chain is mixed: use --neural-cyan (#00F5FF).
Produce CHAIN_DEBUG.md listing issues found and proposed fixes. Get approval before applying.

PHASE 3 — DESIGN TOKEN INJECTION
Create or update the CSS token file with both theme systems:
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════ LIBRA SANCTUARY — Ivory Lobby Theme ═══════════════════════════════════════ */ :root, [data-theme="libra"] { --bg-shell: #E8EAE6; --bg-inner-panel: #F5F7F4; --shadow-organic: inset 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); --fluid-gold: #D4AF37; --silver-filigree: #C0C8D0; --vein-mint: #98B4A6; --btn-glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); --border-organic: 40px 10px 40px 10px; --surface-active: rgba(212,175,55,0.15); }
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════ SCORPIO GRID — Obsidian Neural Theme ═══════════════════════════════════════ */ [data-theme="scorpio"] { --bg-void: #05070A; --bg-grid-plate: #0F1218; --neural-cyan: #00F5FF; --arterial-crimson: #8B0000; --neon-ichor: #FF003F; --toxic-violet: #4B0082; --die-surface: #1A1C22; --die-pip-glow: #00F5FF; --iron-wrought: #2D2D2D; --pulse-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,245,255,0.2); --grid-animation: pulse 4s infinite ease-in-out; }
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════ GEM FACES — used in both themes ═══════════════════════════════════════ */ :root { --gem-1-top: #fde68a; --gem-1-mid: #f59e0b; --gem-1-dark: #78350f; --gem-1-glow: #fbbf24; --gem-2-top: #fca5a5; --gem-2-mid: #ef4444; --gem-2-dark: #7f1d1d; --gem-2-glow: #f87171; --gem-3-top: #86efac; --gem-3-mid: #22c55e; --gem-3-dark: #14532d; --gem-3-glow: #4ade80; --gem-4-top: #c4b5fd; --gem-4-mid: #7c3aed; --gem-4-dark: #2e1065; --gem-4-glow: #a78bfa; --gem-5-top: #bae6fd; --gem-5-mid: #0ea5e9; --gem-5-dark: #0c4a6e; --gem-5-glow: #38bdf8; --gem-6-top: #ddd6fe; --gem-6-mid: #4c1d95; --gem-6-dark: #1a0533; --gem-6-glow: #8b5cf6; }
Apply data-theme="libra" to the lobby root element. Apply data-theme="scorpio" to the game grid root element. The THEME TRANSITION (lobby → game) is a CSS class change + animation (Phase 9).
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PHASE 4 — ISOMETRIC GEM CUBE (H1)
Each die face is a 3-polygon isometric cube SVG. ViewBox 0 0 48 48.
THREE FACE POLYGONS: Top face: M 24,3 L 45,13.5 L 24,24 L 3,13.5 Z (light — --gem-N-top) Left face: M 3,13.5 L 24,24 L 24,45 L 3,34.5 Z (mid — --gem-N-mid) Right face: M 24,24 L 45,13.5 L 45,34.5 L 24,45 Z (dark — --gem-N-dark)
LIBRA VERSION (polished marble): Top face: gradient from rgba(255,255,255,0.4) → --gem-N-top Left face: --gem-N-mid with subtle marble grain (CSS noise texture) Right face: --gem-N-dark with gold-leaf edge: 0.5px --fluid-gold stroke Number: centered, font-black, color #1c1917 (dark on light) HIDDEN by default. Reveals on hover + chain selection.
SCORPIO VERSION (carbon fiber / dark gemstone): Top face: gradient from rgba(255,255,255,0.15) → --gem-N-top at 60% opacity Left face: --gem-N-mid darkened 20%, matte finish Right face: --bg-void with --gem-N-glow bleed at 30% Pips / number: --die-pip-glow (#00F5FF) — glowing eyes in the dark Number: hidden by default. Reveals on hover + chain.
FACE 1 and FACE 5 PREMIUM SIGNAL: These two faces score alone. They must LOOK premium. In both themes: apply a subtle external glow ring (not just color difference). Face 1: ring glow in --fluid-gold (Libra) or --gem-1-glow (Scorpio) Face 5: ring glow in --silver-filigree (Libra) or --gem-5-glow (Scorpio) This teaches players which dice are valuable without reading rules.
FACE 6 SCORPIO PULSE: When multiplier is at ×3.0 or ×4.0, Face 6 dice on the Scorpio grid pulsate with --arterial-crimson shadow (box-shadow: 0 0 16px #8B0000). This signals: "you are in the danger/power zone and this die matters." Animation: 1.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate on shadow opacity.
NUMBER REVEAL BEHAVIOR: Default state: opacity 0 Hover: opacity 1, translateY(-4px), shadow grows (lift effect) Chain selected: opacity 1, float oscillation (translateY -4px to -8px, 1.4s loop) Glow ring on chain: --gem-N-glow color, breathes at 0.8s At-cap (not chained): opacity 0.35, no interaction

PHASE 5 — DIE STATE VISUALS (H2 Block)
H2-A: STONE — "Calcification / Cathedral Floor" The die loses its gem luster and fuses to the grid. CSS class: .state-stone filter: grayscale(0.8) contrast(1.2) background-image: CSS noise texture simulating cracked marble transition: filter 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) animation: none ← bio-pulse STOPS. The organism is dead here. Health = 1 (cracked): Add SVG crack overlay paths on top of the cube. Main crack: diagonal path across left+right faces, white stroke, opacity 0.7 Branch crack: shorter fork from main crack midpoint Moss detail: tiny --vein-mint (#98B4A6) tendril lines sprouting from cracks. These represent the grid organism "reclaiming" the dead stone. Not chainable. Pointer-events: none.
H2-B: ICE — "Cryo-Stasis / Stained Glass Cathedral" The die is preserved in geometric frost — dark cathedral stained glass. CSS class: .state-ice backdrop-filter: blur(4px) background: rgba(173,216,230,0.2) border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5) box-shadow: inset 0 0 15px var(--neural-cyan) clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0% 75%, 0% 25%) Display: ❄️ emoji centered on die face replacing any number. Font size: 60% of cell size. Centered absolutely. CSS filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--neural-cyan)) NOT chainable. Pointer-events: none. Only destroyed by bomb detonation.
H2-C: LOCK — "The Portcullis Binding" The die is held by wrought iron. It CAN be chained (to unlock). CSS class: .state-lock Underlying gem colors still show (face value visible, important for strategy). SVG portcullis overlay (absolutely positioned, full coverage): Three horizontal bars across the cube face, spaced evenly. Two vertical bars. All in --iron-wrought (#2D2D2D). StrokeWidth: 1.5px. The bars cast a shadow over the gem below. Display: 🔒 emoji instead of face number. Apply CSS animation: .neural-pulse @keyframes neural-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity:0.4; transform:scale(1); } 50% { opacity:1; transform:scale(1.2); } } Pulse color: --neon-ichor (#FF003F) ← arterial crimson "bound" signal. Amber outer glow ring: box-shadow 0 0 12px rgba(245,158,11,0.5) On unlock: 🔒 fades out over 300ms. Face number fades in. Bars dissolve.
H2-D: WILD — "Neural Flux / Bioluminescence" The die is a live synapse that hasn't fired. It cycles through the gem palette, waiting to be clamped. CSS class: .state-wild Display: "W" symbol instead of face number. Font-black, white, fills 60% of face area. CSS: font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -0.05em; RAINBOW GLOW ANIMATION: The outer border/ring cycles through gem glow colors: #fbbf24 → #f87171 → #4ade80 → #a78bfa → #38bdf8 → #8b5cf6 @keyframes wild-hue { from { filter: hue-rotate(0deg); } to { filter: hue-rotate(360deg); } } animation: wild-hue 2s linear infinite (on the glow ring only) The die SURFACE stays its underlying face color (critical — keep readable). IS chainable. Pointer-events: normal. When chained: W brightens (opacity 0.6 → 1.0), glow doubles in intensity. Show floating indicator above tile: "→ [resolved face]" in gem glow color. This tells the player what face value Wild resolved to in the current chain. WILD SCATTER WARNING (3+ Wilds on board simultaneously): All Wilds pulse faster: hue-rotate 0.5s instead of 2s. Board shimmer: CSS radial-gradient sweep across entire grid, 800ms, rainbow colors at opacity 0.3. Visual warning: scatter imminent.

PHASE 6 — BOMB SPHERE VISUALS (H-Block extension)
STANDARD BOMB — RED SPHERE OF DESTRUCTION Shape: Perfect sphere with 3D radial gradient. radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #fca5a5, #ef4444 40%, #7f1d1d 75%, #1a0000) Pulsing crimson outer glow: animation: bomb-heartbeat 1.2s ease-in-out infinite @keyframes bomb-heartbeat { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(239,68,68,0.5); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(239,68,68,0.9); } } Fuse: Amber arc at top. Animated spark flickers at tip. Countdown ring: SVG circle stroke-dashoffset draining clockwise. Color: #ef4444 → #fbbf24 when fuseMs < 1000. Pulses double speed at < 1000. Timer text: monospace, white, below sphere.
RAINBOW BOMB — PRISM ORB / NEURAL OVOID Same sphere shape. Surface color cycles through gem glow colors at 300ms each. Outer ring cycles via hue-rotate animation. Feels like the Wild Blocker's sibling — players connect them instinctively.
EXPLOSION EFFECT — BOTH TYPES Phase 1 (0–100ms): Sphere scales up (1 → 2.5x), opacity 1 → 0. Phase 2 (0–300ms): Shockwave ring expands outward from blast center. Standard: deep crimson ring. Rainbow: cycling color ring. Ring opacity 1 → 0 as it expands to blast radius × 2. Phase 3 (100–400ms): Affected tiles dissolve in gem-color sparks (see G2 particles). Phase 4 (200–600ms): Particle burst from center (see G2 particle events). All explosion visuals are CLIENT SIDE ONLY. Game logic (which tiles destroyed) is handled by the engine. Visuals just play.

PHASE 7 — PHYSICS GRAVITY ANIMATION (G1)
REQUIRES: CASCADE_MS approval (current value → 160ms). Ask developer for explicit approval before changing. If denied: implement animation anyway, it will be slightly choppy.
IMPLEMENTATION: Wrap each die tile component in motion.div with layout + layoutId props. layoutId = cell.id (the stable unique tile ID — must not change during play).
motion.div props: layout layoutId={cell.id} transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 280, damping: 22, mass: 0.6 }}
When stepGravity moves a tile to a new grid row, motion/react detects the position change and spring-animates between old and new positions. Result: tiles fall with natural acceleration and a small landing bounce. The spring config gives obsidian/iron "weight" feel — not bouncy plastic.
STONE/ICE/LOCK blockers: DO NOT wrap in layout motion.div. They are immovable. Gravity never applies.
BOMBS: DO wrap in layout motion.div. They fall like die tiles. Fuse counts during fall — do not pause.
FACE 6 "HEAVY IMPACT" SHAKE: When a Face 6 (Obsidian) tile lands on the grid after falling: Apply a subtle translateY shake to the grid container: keyframe: 0% 0px, 15% -3px, 30% 2px, 45% -2px, 60% 1px, 100% 0px duration: 200ms. Scorpio theme only — too heavy for Libra theme. This simulates the weight of an obsidian relic hitting stone.

PHASE 8 — CANVAS PARTICLE SYSTEM (G2 — Gothic Bio Style)
Custom canvas hook. Zero new dependencies. 60–90 lines of TypeScript. Canvas: absolute positioned over grid, full coverage, transparent, pointer-events: none, redraws on requestAnimationFrame.
SIX PARTICLE EVENTS — GOTHIC BIO NAMES:
1. SOLAR DUST (chain commit — scoring) Trigger: chain scores > 0 and commits Particles: 8–12 per tile, in that tile's gem glow color Scorpio theme: motes drift upward "toward the cathedral ceiling" Gold tiles (Face 1): extra brightness, slightly larger particles Behavior: upward arc, gentle sideways drift, slow fade
2. VOID SMOKE (chain commit — Face 6 specific) Trigger: chain includes Face 6 tiles Particles: 6–10 dark violet tendrils from Face 6 tile positions Behavior: downward drift along grid floor, "cling to the crypt" Color: #4c1d95 → #1a0533. Semi-transparent. Low opacity (0.6 max).
3. ARTERIAL BURST (Farkle) Trigger: chain scores 0 Particles: 25–35 crimson particles exploding from chain center Color: #ef4444 and #8B0000 (neon-ichor for largest fragments) Extra: Full-screen desaturation flash — CSS filter: saturate(0) applied to grid for 300ms then eases back to saturate(1) Fragments: 3–5 large (10–18px) tumbling pieces Behavior: fast radial burst, heavy gravity pull-down, fast decay
4. ETHEREAL MISTS (bank success) Trigger: player banks points Particles: 30–45 upward-flowing particles from BankBar Color: #C0C8D0 (silver-filigree) and #D4AF37 (fluid-gold) alternating Behavior: slow upward flow, gentle sway, dissolves as it rises Feels: "Gold ichor flows back up to the Sanctuary" Shape: Mix of small circles and near-invisible rectangles (mist feel)
5. VOID COLLAPSE (Six-of-a-Kind trigger) Trigger: Six-of-a-Kind chain commits (before bomb spawns) Particles: 18–24 gold particles arcing upward like altar offerings Color: #fbbf24 (gold ichor) and #f59e0b (mid gold) Behavior: high arc, slow at peak, gravity pulls back down Size: 8–14px (heavy coin feel) Extra: Brief radial flash at chain center in --fluid-gold
6. RAINBOW PURGE (Straight trigger — before rainbow bomb spawns) Trigger: 1-2-3-4-5-6 Straight chain commits Particles: 6 streams fanning outward, one per gem glow color Each stream: 10–14 particles at 60° intervals from chain center Behavior: fast initial burst, then scatter and fade Feels: all 6 gem energies releasing simultaneously
HOOK INTERFACE: emit(type: ParticleEventType, gridX: number, gridY: number, faceColor?: string) ParticleEventType: 'solar_dust'|'void_smoke'|'arterial_burst'| 'ethereal_mists'|'void_collapse'|'rainbow_purge'

SYNTHESIS SOUNDS (Web Audio API — all gameplay events): Tile select: Crystal tap — high sine 1200Hz, 40ms decay, bone-dry Chain build: Harmonic ping rises per tile (+80Hz each addition) In Scorpio: slightly lower base frequency (800Hz) for darker tone Chain commit: Glass cascade — descending crystal pops, 30ms stagger Farkle: Heavy stone doors slamming — sawtooth 220Hz → 60Hz, 500ms Plus sub-bass thud at impact moment (80Hz, 100ms) Bank: Cathedral chime chord — C major arpeggio, rising, pure tone Bomb tick: Mechanical portcullis click — metallic, precise Bomb detonate: Deep stone impact + debris scatter (multi-frequency burst) Wild activate: Low-frequency thrum — gets louder as color cycle nears gold Lock place: Heavy metallic thunk — "portcullis falling" (120Hz, fast decay) Stone damage: Rock crack — white noise burst with low-frequency impact
HOWLER.JS MUSIC (ambient + adaptive intensity): useMusic hook wraps Howler.js for the following stem system. All stems must be IDENTICAL DURATION for synchronized playback.
LIBRA STATE (lobby/menus): Active stems: ambient only (volume 0.4) Character: choral ambient hum, silver-toned, airy cathedral feel
PRIME LOW (×1.0–×1.25): Active: ambient + strings (volumes 0.5, 0.2) Character: sparse orchestral beneath the drone
PRIME HIGH (×1.5–×2.0): Active: ambient + strings + choir (0.4, 0.4, 0.2) Character: tension building, the cathedral is watching
FRENZY ACTIVE (energy > 150): Active: all four stems (0.3, 0.5, 0.4, 0.5) Character: full Gothic Bio symphony — the organism is alive
BOMB COUNTDOWN (fuseMs < 1500): Reduce ambient/strings to 0.2, raise choir to 0.6, electronic to 0.7 Add bomb-tick stinger loop on top Character: the crypt is about to collapse
CROSSFADE: 1500ms between all state transitions. Never cut abruptly.
REQUIRED FILES (developer sources these): public/music/ambient.mp3 — dark drone, vine/gothic texture, looped public/music/strings.mp3 — sparse dark orchestral, same duration public/music/choir.mp3 — gothic choir tension layer, same duration public/music/electronic.mp3 — bioluminescent pulse, same duration public/stingers/farkle.mp3 — 2–3s stone slamming, descending public/stingers/bank.mp3 — 3s cathedral chime resolve, ascending public/stingers/bomb.mp3 — 1s portcullis tick, loopable public/stingers/heist.mp3 — dissonant gothic tension, loopable

PHASE 10 — MULTIPLIER LADDER (F-Block Visual)
The ladder is the Celestial Vault. It lives in the Libra Lobby and bleeds into the Scorpio Grid as the player climbs.
LADDER STEP VISUAL DESIGN: Each step is a floating platform — asymmetric organic border-radius. Inactive steps: --silver-filigree border, dark fill, subdued label Active step: gem-echo glow (see color map below), elevated z-index
Step 0 (×1.0): #94a3b8 — slate. Neutral. "You have earned nothing yet." Step 1 (×1.25): #4ade80 — jade. "First growth." Step 2 (×1.5): #38bdf8 — steel crystal. "The silver prize tier." Step 3 (×2.0): #fbbf24 — gold ichor. Matches Face 1 — premium die milestone. box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212,175,55,0.6) Step 4 (×3.0): #fb923c — amber heat. No gem echo — this is the WARNING zone. Pulse animation: border flickers red → amber. Step 5 (×4.0): #a78bfa — obsidian echo. Matches Face 6. Deep pulse: 0 0 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.8) In Scorpio theme: this step's glow bleeds into bg.
LADDER TRANSITIONS: Advancing: step lights up with a brief upward particle burst (Solar Dust). Farkle reset: all steps flash --neon-ichor red, then extinguish cascade top→bottom. Bank reset: steps extinguish cascade bottom→top (reverse — "banking back down").

PHASE 11 — Z-PROTOCOL: THE THEME TRANSITION
This is the emotional peak of the visual design. The transition from Libra Sanctuary → Scorpio Grid is a narrative beat.
ENTERING THE GRID ("The Descent"): Duration: 800ms total. Frame 0–200ms: Screen develops hairline cracks (CSS pseudo-element overlay, SVG crack paths animated stroke-dashoffset to "draw" the cracks). Frame 200–500ms: Cracks glow --neon-ichor (#FF003F) — like the crypt bleeding through. Frame 500–800ms: The screen "shatters" — each crack panel fades to Scorpio dark. Libra alabaster drains away. Obsidian floods in. data-theme switches from "libra" to "scorpio". Frame 600–800ms: Scorpio grid elements animate in from below (translateY: 20px → 0). Audio: crack SFX + low-frequency thud as obsidian locks in.
RETURNING TO LOBBY ("The Ascension" — after Bank): Duration: 600ms. Frame 0–300ms: Gold particles (Ethereal Mists) rise from BankBar, spreading across the screen. Frame 300–600ms: Gold mists solidify into Libra alabaster. data-theme switches from "scorpio" to "libra". Audio: cathedral chime resolve (bank.mp3 stinger).
FARKLE COLLAPSE ("The Ruin"): Duration: 1000ms. Frame 0–300ms: Arterial Burst particles. Grid shakes. Screen desaturates. Frame 300–600ms: Everything dims to near-black except a single glowing red "Scorpio eye" at screen center. Implement as SVG circle with --neon-ichor glow, pulsing. Frame 600–1000ms: Eye fades. Transition to Libra lobby — but darker, slower than a normal ascension. "You return to nothing." Audio: stone slamming SFX + heavy silence before choral drone resumes.

BEAUTY MANDATE — applies to all phases without exception
LIGHT SOURCE: Top-left on all 3D surfaces. Shadow bottom-right. Always. DEPTH: Nothing is flat. Every surface has a visible third dimension. MOTION: Primary events = large visible impact. Background = subtle, breathing. BREATHING: The Scorpio grid pulses at 4s ease-in-out. The player feels it alive. COLOR SIGNAL: Players learn which dice are valuable from color — not from reading. Gold and Steel must look premium vs. the neutral groupers. PERFORMANCE: 60fps on low-end Android. Max 80 simultaneous particles. Limit backdrop-filter to 3 simultaneous elements. CSS over JS for all repeating animations. TYPOGRAPHY: Numbers/scores: JetBrains Mono, font-weight 900. Labels: Inter or system-ui, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.08em. Die face numbers: monospace, embedded in die face. Blocker emoji: system emoji font, large, centered.
